fn Power(base: Int, exp: Int) -> Int
  requires (exp >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (exp == 0) then 1 else (base * Power(base, (exp - 1)))))
  effects pure
  example (Power(0, 0) == 1)
  example (Power(0, 1) == 0)
{
  if (exp == 0) then 1 else (base * Power(base, (exp - 1)))
}

fn solve(n: Int, k: Int) -> Int
  requires (1 <= n)
  requires (n <= 1000)
  requires (2 <= k)
  requires (k <= 1000)
  ensures (result == (k * Power((k - 1), (n - 1))))
  ensures (result > 0)
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0) == 0)
{
  0
}
